说明: 内置 image_gen 的原始生成输入记录。中文评审说明见 README.md；英文 prompt 保留原始输入供后续复现与修改。
用途: 静态原型评审，不作为已实现页面或品牌最终定稿。

页面.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop web app screen for “拾灵”, a Chinese open-source asset library. This is the TEAM ASSET LIBRARY screen, not a marketing page or an analytics dashboard. Target 1440 × 1024, flat front-on full viewport, no browser chrome, device frame, perspective or external captions. Entire UI in accurate Simplified Chinese, readable sans-serif typography (14–16px body), crisp icons and precise alignments.
Visual direction: quiet, refined, practical creative-tool UI. Warm near-white canvas #F7F8F5, pale sidebar #F0F3EF, charcoal #23342D typography, deep forest green #285C47 primary controls, thin subtle dividers, modest 8–12px corner radii. Lots of breathing room but useful working density. Color comes from rich material thumbnails, not interface decoration. No glassmorphism, glowing gradients, KPI cards, oversized hero, decorative charts, repeated nested cards.
Layout: 208px left sidebar, main workspace filling remaining width. Top left a tiny simple four-petal geometric mark followed by “拾灵”. Sidebar navigation: “素材库” selected with pale-green background, “集合”, “我的收藏”, “上传任务”. Bottom auxiliary “归档” and small “个人账户”, no member names or admin features. Main top: large “素材库”, small subtitle “团队的灵感与创作素材”; on the right dark-green “＋ 上传素材”. Beneath: wide search input “搜索标题、标签或说明” with search icon; compact type tabs “全部”“图片”“视频”“动效”, secondary filters “标签”“集合”“仅我上传”, right-side “最近上传” and grid/list toggle. Clear, clean header hierarchy.
Main gallery: four equal columns and two full rows plus a partial third row of large genuinely beautiful thumbnail-first assets, roomy 18–22px gaps, each thumbnail roughly 4:3. Below each image one concise Chinese title and subdued format/size line, tiny visible type cue, subtle favorite outline. Mix art-directed mock assets: cream and vermilion citrus editorial poster called “夏日果实”, translucent cobalt glass sculpture called “蓝色玻璃”, forest-green flowing ribbons on black called “流光交互动效” with ZIP cue and play symbol, cinematic misty forest video called “山间晨雾” with MP4/00:18 cue; second row sculptural beige chair photography, bold minimalist Chinese typographic poster, terracotta architecture photograph, peach and green abstract artwork. Images must be detailed and editorially compelling, not empty placeholder gradients. Only a few restrained “已公开” status labels; other content is team-accessible. No people avatars on cards, no invented rating/comments/AI/approval/share-password features. Final image should look like an excellent realistic Chinese creative asset manager ready for design review. All material content and names are fictional examples.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new high-fidelity desktop screen, 1440 × 1024, for the Chinese asset manager “拾灵”. Input image is a VISUAL STYLE AND ASSET REFERENCE, not a screen to repeat. Match its warm pale background, compact 208px left sidebar, dark forest-green primary button, restrained 8–12px corners, thin dividers, generous working space, crisp Chinese type, and tiny four-petal brand mark. Keep sidebar “素材库”“集合”“我的收藏”“上传任务”, bottom “归档”“个人账户”. No browser/device frame.
This screen is the signed-in OWNER'S ASSET DETAIL for “蓝色玻璃”, the same sculptural translucent cobalt-blue glass object from the reference. This is a full detail deep-link page inside the app, not a gallery or dashboard. Header: subtle “← 返回素材库”; title “蓝色玻璃”; status “仅团队”. Small overflow menu at upper right.
Large two-column body: left about 70% is an excellent sharp high-resolution preview of the blue glass sculpture from the reference, studio lighting on a very pale blue-gray surface, generous clean stage without unnecessary borders. Small bottom-centered zoom toolbar “适应” and “− 100% ＋”, subtle and believable.
Right about 30% is a clean white information/operations column separated only by one faint vertical divider. Title “蓝色玻璃”, a quiet green status “仅团队成员可见”, short readable description “通透的蓝色玻璃造型，适合材质探索与视觉提案。” then label “标签” with small existing tag chips “蓝色”“材质”“3D”. A light structured definition list: “格式” “PNG”; “尺寸” “4032 × 3024”; “大小” “8.7 MB”. No fabricated dates or uploader identities needed. Text-link action “编辑信息”. At bottom of info section a full-width dark-green primary “下载原图”; below it restrained outlined secondary “公开素材”. Small quiet copy below secondary: “公开后，游客可查看并下载原文件。” Under these a horizontal small-action row “收藏” and “加入集合”; another modest “复制团队链接” text action. Arrange enough whitespace so buttons do not feel crowded.
All UI text accurate Simplified Chinese, 14–16px normal text, sensible 26–30px title. Everything visible and legible, no lorem ipsum. Match the asset and app style of reference. Do NOT add comments, likes counters, AI edits, licensing claims, member profiles, history versions, replace-original buttons, delete buttons, a published status, or a second visual concept. This is static design-review UI with fictional sample content, no implementation annotations printed inside the app.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity 1440 × 1024 desktop app screenshot for “拾灵”, showing the UPLOAD WORKSPACE. The reference image supplies the exact visual system: warm off-white base, 208px pale green-gray sidebar, four-petal mark and Chinese brand, forest green primary controls, charcoal text, restrained thin rules, 8–12px corners, clean Chinese typography at readable 14–16px. No device or browser frame. Preserve reference sidebar labels but select “上传任务” instead of “素材库”: “素材库”“集合”“我的收藏”“上传任务”; auxiliary “归档”“个人账户”. Do not repeat the gallery.
Main workspace top: heading “上传工作区”, subtle subtitle “管理文件传输与处理进度”, top-right green “＋ 添加文件”. Immediately below a compact pale-green information line reading exactly “处理合格后团队成员可见；公开需要另外操作。” Below that a shallow wide drop area with delicate dashed border, small upload icon, “拖入图片、MP4 或 HTML/ZIP 动效”, second short line “也可以点击添加文件”. No invented file size limits.
Below drop area, header “本次上传 · 4 项”, subtitle “1 项可用 · 2 项进行中 · 1 项失败”. A calm small linear stage explanation “传输 → 核验 → 处理 → 团队可用”. No analytics dashboard or stat cards.
Main content is one clean spacious TABLE with light horizontal separators, not four separate cards. Columns “文件”“状态”“整理”“操作”. Four rows, each 110–120px high with small beautiful thumbnail, bold readable filename and muted size:
1. warm pastel image thumbnail, “晨光渐层.png”, “PNG · 1.8 MB”; green check and “团队可用”, smaller “处理完成”; gray outline “选择标签”; action text “查看素材”.
2. sea-cliff video thumbnail, “山海片段.mp4”, “MP4 · 36.5 MB”; “上传中 65%” and a slim green progress bar filled exactly 65%; gray “选择标签”; action “取消”.
3. paper confetti on cream preview, “纸片转场.zip”, “ZIP · 4.2 MB”; subdued spinner and “等待处理”, smaller “文件已接收”; gray “选择标签”; action “取消”. DO NOT show percentage for processing.
4. fine geometric light-grid preview, “流动光栅.html”, “HTML · 260 KB”; restrained terracotta error icon and “处理失败”, smaller “处理超时，可重试”; gray “选择标签”; small outlined button “重试处理”, plus quiet “查看原因”. Failure is transient processing timeout after reception; do not ask to upload again.
A modest bottom note “上传中的文件请保持页面开启；已接收文件会继续后台处理。” Lots of clean whitespace, realistic functional proportions, no severe alert banners. Every Chinese label must be accurate and legible. Do not show publish actions, permanent delete, approvals, administrator features, auto-publication, fake processing percentages or successful states for pending items. Fictional examples only.
页面.refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit of a UI mockup. The supplied image is the exact edit target. Preserve this entire Chinese “拾灵” upload workspace screen exactly: layout, typography, every Chinese string, table rows, status, controls, background, brand, colors, dimensions and all other pixels as much as possible.
Make ONLY these two local changes:
1. In the THIRD table row, the thumbnail immediately left of “纸片转场.zip”, which is still waiting for processing, replace the paper artwork with a neutral pale gray-green file-type placeholder. Use a simple fine-line folded-document / archive icon centered with a small crisp “ZIP” label. It must not look like an actual rendered preview.
2. In the FOURTH table row, immediately left of “流动光栅.html”, which has failed processing, replace the green light-grid artwork with a matching neutral pale gray-green file-type placeholder. Use a simple fine-line document/code icon centered with a small crisp “HTML” label. No rendered motion artwork.
Keep the first image preview and second video thumbnail unchanged. Do not change any file names, statuses, buttons, table widths, totals or progress bar. This targeted change clarifies that an unprocessed or failed HTML/ZIP package does not have a successful motion preview. No extra annotations.
页面.note: 最终图使用修正版；等待处理与失败的动效使用文件类型图标。

页面.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity Chinese desktop public asset gallery for “拾灵”, 1440 × 1024, flat product viewport, no browser/device frame. The provided image is a VISUAL STYLE reference: preserve forest-green #285C47 accents, warm white #F7F8F5 canvas, charcoal readable Chinese type, tiny four-petal geometric brand, restrained corners and crisp editorial material thumbnails. This is a NEW PUBLIC VISITOR SCREEN, not the signed-in team workspace.
Critical structure: NO sidebar at all. A slim full-width header, brand “拾灵” at left, a small descriptor “公开素材”, and a restrained outlined “团队登录” at far right. Below, content within comfortable 64px side margins. Main heading “发现灵感，找到好素材” around 32px, not a giant marketing hero. One short subtitle “浏览已公开的图片、视频与动效，无需登录即可预览和下载。” Next a broad search field “搜索公开素材” and then simple filters “全部”“图片”“视频”“动效”, “公开标签” dropdown, right aligned “最近公开”. No upload, members, account avatar, collections, favorites workspace, owner filter, internal status or admin controls.
The dominant surface is a premium four-column gallery with large beautiful thumbnail previews and generous gaps. Two complete rows and a partial third row. Each card has ONE short public Chinese title and small public tag chips; optional MP4 duration or ZIP/HTML cue on appropriate preview. No original upload filenames, creator identities, avatars, badges claiming free commercial use, star counts, team totals or metadata dates.
Reuse only these already-public reference assets: the cream/vermilion citrus artwork “夏日果实”; cinematic misty forest “山间晨雾” with play cue and “00:18”; minimalist white/forest-green typographic poster “山与风”. Add distinct fictional PUBLIC examples: “纸间轻舞” (cream folded paper motion, ZIP play cue), “光影建筑” (terracotta arch photo), “海面微光” (ocean video play cue 00:12), “几何呼吸” (muted green graphic web motion, HTML cue), “白色花序” (delicate white flowers on green background). IMPORTANT: Do not include the blue glass object “蓝色玻璃” or “流光交互动效”, which are team-only in other prototype screens. Do not show the waiting/failed upload items.
For the first card, show a tasteful hover action overlay “查看素材” and “下载原图” so it is clear visitors can use materials without signing in. Other cards remain clean. Example public tags like “海报”“自然”“抽象” are readable text, not internal identifiers. Material photography and artwork should be excellent, nuanced and vivid while the interface stays calm. All UI words in accurate Simplified Chinese; no generic wireframe placeholders or feature inventory. No repeated screenshots, only this single public page.
